mintAuthority.summary: xDAI has no independent local ERC-20 or native issuer: it is a Gnosis-native balance representation of the inherited USDS issuance path. The xDAI bridge's validator quorum, escrow, limits, governance, and upgrades are assessed in Bridge Risk, while USDS parent issuance remains attributable to usds-sky.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16: xDAI is native to Gnosis Chain and the tracked WXDAI contract is only a WETH-style wrapper, so no independent local xDAI issuer or native token contract is claimed. The reviewed xDAI route is USDS escrow on Ethereum followed by validator-affirmed Home Bridge credit through BlockReward, with xDAI burned before USDS release in the reverse path. Its 4-of-7 validators, bridge limits, 8-of-15 governance Safes, bridge proxy upgrades, and no observed timelock remain fully scoreable under Bridge Risk; they are not native Mint Authority controls. The USDS issuance path remains inherited from usds-sky.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: xDAI has no independent local native-issuance contract; its Gnosis-native balance is a bridge representation of the inherited USDS parent path, and the tracked WXDAI contract is only a local wrapper.
